storage.notes: Records to microSD (up to 512GB, not included) standalone, or to HomeBase S380 (64GB built-in, expandable to 16TB). No HomeBase required.

features: Dual-lens bullet-PTZ: upper 2K wide-angle bullet + lower 4K PTZ
360 auto-tracking with 8x auto zoom (details up to 33 ft)
HomeBase S380 optional (BionicMind AI, cross-cam tracking)

frigate.notes: RTSP is served by the HomeBase S380, not the camera. Enable in eufy Security app. Standalone (no HomeBase) is P2P/app only.

home_assistant.notes: No native ONVIF on the camera; use the HomeBase RTSP stream as a Generic Camera, or the eufy-security HACS integration (P2P).

blue_iris.notes: Not a Hikvision/ONVIF brand — use the HomeBase RTSP URL as a Generic/RTSP source (no ONVIF).
